'''Chalcedon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

During the [[Pre-Republic era]], Chalcedon was ruled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. A rocky and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world with a semi-breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], it was the hub of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]]. Chalcedon had no indigenous life-forms, but there was a way station and two colonies, with buildings made out of the local dark volcanic glass.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Chalcedon|Chalcedon]] was an ancient town in the [[Wikipedia:ancient Rome|Roman]] province of [[Wikipedia:Bithynia|Bithynia]], on the shores of the [[Wikipedia:Black Sea|Black Sea]].
